# Libretro API header

`libretro.h` is vendored from the official libretro-common repository at the
immutable commit below. The file SHA-256 is `5b6d8fe1056a39591ee6c479512eed4a6f6efd8f89f64f10cf8b4757a2aa48a0`.

- Source: https://github.com/libretro/libretro-common/blob/52781c4a8b5aae19d858f4a2326c8f8308c70f54/include/libretro.h
- Raw file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/libretro/libretro-common/52781c4a8b5aae19d858f4a2326c8f8308c70f54/include/libretro.h
- Upstream revision: `52781c4a8b5aae19d858f4a2326c8f8308c70f54`
- License: MIT; the complete copyright and permission notice is retained at the top of `libretro.h`.
- Maintenance owner: Gamebloke maintainers. Refresh only from an explicitly reviewed upstream revision and update this digest.

No Libretro runtime or helper dependency is added; this header defines the ABI
used by the local frontend adapter.
